spec.description:
Retrieve information about the API key used to make the request, including its name, permissions, restrictions, and usage timestamps.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `None`

otp.description: Two-factor authentication password, required only if 2FA is configured for the API key.

response.title: ApiKeyInfo
response.description: Information about the API key used to make the request.

apiKeyName.description: Name/label assigned to the API key.

nonce.description: Current nonce value tracked for the API key.

nonceWindow.description: Custom nonce window value (0 if not configured).

permissions.description: Permissions assigned to the API key. Values correspond to the API key permission settings: `query-funds` (Funds - Query), `add-funds` (Funds - Deposit), `withdraw-funds` (Funds - Withdraw), `earn-funds` (Funds - Earn), `query-open-trades` (Orders and trades - Query open orders & trades), `query-closed-trades` (Orders and trades - Query closed orders & trades), `modify-trades` (Orders and trades - Create & modify orders), `close-trades` (Orders and trades - Cancel & close orders), `query-ledger` (Data - Query ledger entries), `export-data` (Data - Export data), `create-ws-token` (WebSocket interface - On), `add-withdraw-address` (Add withdrawal addresses), `update-withdraw-address` (Update withdrawal addresses).

iban.description: IIBAN (Internal IBAN) of the account associated with the API key.

validUntil.description: Unix timestamp for key expiration (0 if not set).

queryFrom.description: Unix timestamp for the earliest allowed query date (0 if not set).

queryTo.description: Unix timestamp for the latest allowed query date (0 if not set).

createdTime.description: Unix timestamp of when the API key was created.

modifiedTime.description: Unix timestamp of when the API key was last modified.

ipAllowlist.description: IP addresses/ranges allowed to use this API key (empty if unrestricted).

lastUsed.description: Unix timestamp of when the API key was last used (`null` if never used).

notes: Dropped the redundant `spot.account.get_api_key_info` -> `spot.account.api_key_info` prefix per the `Get`-drop naming convention. `permissions` items are enumerated against the 13-value table the description documents.
